units.source_text: 我在旅馆的室内浴池洗澡，汉子跟着走进来。

en.t: I was bathing in the inn's indoor bath when the man followed me in.

units.source_text: 他说，他快二十四岁了，妻子两次怀孕，不是流产，就是早产，胎儿都死了。

en.t: He said that he was almost twenty-four, and that his wife had been pregnant twice, but each time the child had died, either through miscarriage or premature birth.

units.source_text: 他穿着印有长冈温泉字号的和服短外褂，起先我以为他是长冈人。

en.t: He was wearing a short kimono jacket printed with the name of Nagaoka Hot Springs, so at first I thought he was from Nagaoka.

units.source_text: 从长相和言谈来看，他是相当有知识的。

en.t: Judging from his appearance and the way he spoke, he was quite knowledgeable.

units.source_text: 我想，他要么是出于好奇，要么是迷上了卖艺的姑娘，才帮忙拿行李跟着来的。

en.t: I thought he must have helped carry the luggage and come along either out of curiosity or because he had become infatuated with the performing girl.
